$comment: The analytics remote's own translations, registered by remote-entry.js at mount time and merged into the shell's message table. The shell's manifest does not list these keys and does not need to.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.lead: This screen imports nothing from the shell: no Lit, no signals, no template compiler. It builds DOM by hand and reaches the session only through the capability context it was handed at mount.
analytics.anonymous: No session. Nothing here can be fetched.
analytics.signedInAs: Signed in as {name} ({subject}). The context carries an identity and no token.
analytics.mount: Mounted at {mount}, which comes from the manifest rather than from this folder.
analytics.signInFirst: Sign in to load the summary.
analytics.updated: Generated at {at}, formatted with this remote's own Intl calls and the shell's locale.
analytics.exportStub: Nothing is exported: the button exists to show that it is rendered only for a session carrying analytics:write.
analytics.probe: Call an API this remote is not granted
analytics.leastPrivilege: The manifest grants this remote one API prefix and two permissions. Anything else throws before a request leaves the browser, and the message names the remote, the path and the grants it does have.
